Data & sync
Cloud sync
Schedule cloud sync (Tsinghua email calendar)
Use your Tsinghua email's calendar service to sync manually added schedules across devices — schedules added in OneTHU appear in the system calendar / other devices signed in with the same account. To get an app password: webmail (mails.tsinghua.edu.cn) → Settings → client-specific password.
Save and verify
System calendar sync
This platform does not support writing directly to the system calendar; export an .ics from the "Schedule" page and import it.
External homework
Merges each platform's assignment deadlines into "All assignments" and "Today"; read-only fetch (title / course / due date). It never submits or downloads problem content. Sign-in info is stored encrypted on this device and used only to read assignments.
